correctness.rationale: The construction checks exactly. For n=6,7,8, direct enumeration gives |P_full|=4, |F|=14,60,362 and verifies every pair in F agrees in at least two positions; the rook formula gives the same deletion counts and yields the stated n=9,10 sizes. For n≥7, C0 contains R, whereas any other 2-coset shares at most one defining equation with C0 and therefore contains at most (n-3)! points of R plus the four exceptional P_full points. The submitted inequality |R|>(n-3)!+4 then makes C0 the maximizing 2-coset, hence gamma_2(F)=4. The inclusion-exclusion/rook factorization and the 1/e asymptotic are consistent with the displayed finite formula.

originality.rationale: Ellis’s exact stability theorem supplies the first nontrivial extremal family D and, for t=2, its exceptional part has diversity 2. The submitted construction is structurally different: it uses a transverse (n-3)-coset leaving exactly four points outside C0 and derives an exact rook-theoretic deletion count. The more recent Wang–Xiao diversity result treats ordinary (t=1) intersecting families, not 2-intersecting permutation families. Thus the construction is not a specialization of the cited stability theorems and provides a genuinely new candidate at the next diversity threshold.

scientific_value.rationale: Although the large-n upper bound and equality classification remain open, an explicit infinite diversity-4 family with a closed exact size and the same first-order (1-1/e)(n-2)! scale as the first stability barrier is useful extremal information. It gives a concrete sharpness target for the requested gamma_2≥3 problem and a nontrivial rook-theoretic model against which future upper-bound arguments can be tested.

independent_checks: Independently reconstructed C0, the transverse (n-3)-coset M, P_full=M\C0, and R for n=6,7,8; obtained |P_full|=4 and |F|=14,60,362 with pairwise 2-intersection.
Re-evaluated the supplied rook formula U(n), matching the brute deletion counts for n=6,7,8 and the reported formula values for n=9,10.
Checked the Delta_2 argument: any non-C0 2-coset contributes at most (n-3)! core points plus four outside points, while C0 contributes |R| for n≥7.
Verified that the record clearly limits itself to the construction/lower-bound side and does not claim the conjectural all-large-n upper bound.
limitations: The all-large-n upper bound and equality classification remain open, exactly as the record states.
Small-n search evidence beyond the proved construction is not used as a theorem in this audit.
No inaccessible source is represented as read.

sources.note: David Ellis, Stability for t-intersecting families of permutations: exact first-level nontrivial stability; for t=2 the extremal D has two exceptional permutations outside the core 2-coset.
Wang–Xiao maximum-diversity theorem concerns ordinary intersecting (t=1) permutation families, not the 2-intersecting gamma_2 problem.
